name: Textarea
purpose: Render finished native multi-line text entry with Brick sizing, states, resize policy, and Atom field integration.
useWhen: The user enters sentences, paragraphs, notes, or other multi-line text.

avoidWhen.condition: The expected value is short and single-line.

composition: Place Textarea inside one Field.Root after Field.Label and add description or character guidance when useful.
Use the default outline recipe beside outline Input when both controls should blend into the same owning surface.

rules.statement: Use the shared token-only radius contract only on the public parts listed in docs/guides/radius.md. Omit it to retain the owner default; do not combine it with legacy corner shape or forward it to native elements. Core names and semantic roles are distinct; popup boundaries are independent of their triggers.
Load styles.css or core.css plus textarea.css and field.css when composed with Field.
Keep outline Textarea and outline Input on the same transparent surface recipe within one form.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using a single-line Input for long freeform content.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Textarea and allow a usable multi-line measure.

validation: Inspect label, name, and messaging relationships.
Test multi-line entry, resize policy, narrow widths, invalid/disabled states, and contrast.
